userText:
Building: Basilique du Sacré-Cœur, Paris (basilica).
The front (−z) is the south front at the top of the steps, looking out over Paris.
Footprint: 50.1 m along x by 95.9 m along z, centred on the origin.
Outline (from OpenStreetMap), [x, z] in metres, going round:
[[-19.8,-35.7],[-19.9,-39.5],[-10.6,-39.2],[-9.3,-47.7],[9.2,-48],[9.2,-44],[10.6,-43.9],[10.5,-39.1],[19.9,-39.2],[21,-34.7],[25,-34.3],[25.1,6.7],[21.6,6.7],[21.6,14.6],[24,18.6],[23.9,21.3],[20.7,24.3],[19.3,30.7],[14.6,32.2],[10.8,37.4],[7,37.6],[7.2,48],[-7.3,47.9],[-7.1,37.3],[-11.5,36.9],[-13.9,32.9],[-19.1,31],[-20.6,28.6],[-20.6,24.3],[-24.4,20.9],[-24.2,17.3],[-21.8,14.5],[-21.7,6.7],[-25,7],[-25.1,-34],[-21.5,-34.1]]
Height: the highest point is 84 m above the ground.

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. full front from the gardens below the hill, daylight: the white domes over the terraces and steps
  2. front three-quarter from the left (west), daylight: the arched portico, the main dome and the smaller domes
  3. the front close up, daylight: the main dome on its drum with the smaller domes around it

Reply with the JSON object only.

json.notes: The Sacré-Cœur is a white travertine basilica whose main mass is a long body with a great central dome on a drum, flanked by two domed towers and two spired turrets at the front. The portico with its round arches sits at the foot of the front, facing −z. The plan's components are modelled as the central rotunda dome, the main body block, the two domed towers, the two spired turrets and the three-arch portico.
